test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In India, a microfinance loan is defined as a collateral-free loan given to a household having an annual income of up to Rs _________ as of October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs 3 lakhs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A loan without security issued to a household with an annual household income of up to 3,00,000 is referred to as a microfinance loan.
 
• The criterion for household income was standardized between rural and urban families under the new regulations, which went into effect on April 1, 2022, and the cap was raised to 300,000 rupees for all lenders, including banks, non-banking financial institutions, and stand-alone microlenders.
 
• A non-banking financial organization previously classified as a microfinance institution used a household income cap of 125,000 rupees for rural areas and 200,000 for urban and semi-urban areas to identify microfinance borrowers.
 
• The loan ceiling for private borrowers was established at 125,000 rupees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Any guidelines, circulars, notifications, regulations, rules, or other restrictions, as well as any decisions or determinations relevant to taxes, common currency, financial stability standards, and other prudential standards on revenue recognition, asset valuation, and provisioning relative to disbursements by banks and financial institutions, liquidity, reserve requirements, reserve assets, special deposit cash ratios, capital asset requirements, or any other form of regulation, are referred to as RBI directions.
